text: I think you might enjoy this Overnight Peaches & Cream French Toast recipe. The combination of fresh peaches and creamy half-and-half sounds like a great match for your taste in sweet and savory flavors. While it doesn't feature any of your usual go-to ingredients like ginger or sesame oil, the use of fresh peaches and eggs suggests a recipe that's both comforting and slightly healthier. Given that it's ready in about 30 minutes, it also fits within your typical time frame for cooking.
